scope: Editorial review of two original additions on bacterial envelopes and susceptibility-test measurements by the sole integrator

conflicts.resolution: DAB3: citation overlay hides central labels; only visible image text read. Excluded from fully read and integrated pages. Article DOI10.3390/pharmaceutics16091137 identified; not read in full, original figure not inspected independently.
Membrane synthesis label not imported. EMA5.1 supports membrane binding/depolarisation for daptomycin, not a generic synthesis mechanism for all membrane-active drugs.
APP-II21 and RANG general innocuity language not transferred as dose escalation or absence of adverse effects; selective toxicity separated from clinical safety.
APP-II22–24: current EUCAST I is susceptible increased exposure, not uncertain intermediate or resistant. Exposure not reduced to larger dose; no dose instruction.
APP-II24 lysis equivalence corrected using EMA daptomycin mechanism. Static/cidal not used to rank efficacy or declare immune defenses irrelevant.
APP-II22/24: broad spectrum not equal activity against every Gram positive/negative isolate. Scope, isolate, site and exposure distinguished.
APP-II24 never-use wording replaced with common MIC versus distinct MBC measurement, consistent with KATZ1032; no routine MBC recommendation.
APP-II21 places nitrofurans among30S inhibitors. This figure is not an independent authoritative target catalog; no such mechanism imported, no illustration republished.
PDF935 final trimethoprim sentence continues936. Whole visible page read; continuation and quantitative selectivity not inferred. RANG ebook print-page labels not invented.
Only named intervals read. Other FarmacoI/II lessons and contributions from other lecturers not newly read for this introductory batch. Broader reconciliation remains open.
Gram stain and morphology separated; example photographs do not establish that every coccus is Gram positive or every rod Gram negative.

DAB8 three-layer shorthand reconciled with KATZ909 and RANG952: outer membrane, periplasm containing peptidoglycan, cytoplasmic membrane distinguished. Porins are compound-dependent channels, not unrestricted access for every hydrophilic antibiotic.

DAB10 MIC heading does not turn a disk diffusion photograph into a direct MIC measurement. EUCAST selected method and calibration passages support diameter in mm versus concentration and combination-specific interpretation.

DAB10: disk-diffusion plate photographs do not provide readable disk identities and ruler graduations or sufficient method metadata. Partial page excluded from complete reading and integration; no diameter or MIC inferred.
RANG951: body text read, embedded raster table not fully verified; conservatively counted as partial and excluded from integration.

KATZ908 generalized carbapenem beta-lactamase resistance caption, historical units/regimens, RANG952 sulfonamide-use list and prasugrel classification not imported or independently validated. APP-II25 PK/PD targets, guaranteed cure wording and historical TDM availability claims excluded from this envelope/test-method scope.
KATZ909 ends mid-word before PDF910; only completed mechanism text and complete figure43.3 used. KATZ907–908 and APP-II25 fully read as visible pages but not integrated. Continuations not inferred.
Embedded figure credits (Tortora1989 and McGraw-Hill) recorded privately; underlying originals not independently inspected. No source image reproduced.
